notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed issue with taking off the jacket
- Fixed clicking on toggle switches inside a closed rocket in a warehouse
- Fixed a problem with the end of the day or loss when in a personal file or updater
- If the missiles received from the warehouse were not launched and were not removed, then the next day they will be returned
- Added hint for secret achievement because it is VERY HARD
- Fix Korean language, text disappeared
- Fixed problem with fake button switching when dragging with the mouse
- Fixed problems with getting stuck in texture
- Changed the texture of the resource pack to 400 units 

If you have questions or suggestions for cooperation, write in our discord channel or email: info@tor-studio.com
